<thought>By examining the 13C NMR data, the carbon signals in the upfield region (≈10‑30 ppm) correspond to methyl carbons. The spectrum shows distinct peaks at 16.60, 19.40, 24.56, 34.00, and 57.20 ppm, each representing a separate CH₃ carbon. Therefore, the molecule contains five methyl groups.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
